A sword that has become so thoroughly rusted, it is impossible to discern its original shape.|Allies|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 6 |durability = 8 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Rusty Broadsword}} Rusty Broadswords are a type of [[Weapon]] known to break easily due to their age. They can commonly found in [[Hyrule Field]] and [[Eldin Canyon]], where they either have been abandoned or are wielded by low-level [[Enemy|Enemies]]. One spawns in a stone on a small island in a lake near the [[Temple of Time]] on the [[Great Plateau]]. They also have a chance to appear in [[Treasure Chest]]s that spawn when the {{BotW}} Series [[Guardian]] [[amiibo]] is scanned with the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] [[Rune]]. [[Rock Octorok]]s will inhale Rusty Broadswords when they are placed in front of them, spitting back out a cleaned counterpart.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 169}} There's a 50% chance for a [[Traveler's Sword]], a 35% chance for a [[Soldier's Broadsword]], a 10% chance for a [[Knight's Broadsword]], and a 5% chance for a [[Royal Broadsword]]. Rusty Broadswords are made of metal, so they can attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s and conduct [[Electricity]]. They will sink in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]] and can be picked up using the [[Magnesis]] Rune. If they are exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]], they will not burn like wooden Weapons do.
